# technitium_settings_logging (Resource)

Manages logging and statistics retention.

This is a singleton: declare it once. Attributes left unset follow the server's current value. Destroying the resource only removes it from state; server settings are not reset.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enable_in_memory_stats` (Boolean) Keep stats in memory only.
- `enable_logging` (Boolean) Enable logging.
- `ignore_resolver_logs` (Boolean) Don't log resolver errors.
- `log_folder` (String) Log folder path on the server.
- `log_queries` (Boolean) Log every query.
- `logging_type` (String) `None`, `File`, `Console` or `FileAndConsole`.
- `max_log_file_days` (Number) Days to keep log files; 0 keeps forever.
- `max_stat_file_days` (Number) Days to keep stats files; 0 keeps forever.
- `no_stack_trace` (Boolean) Omit stack traces from error logs.
- `use_local_time` (Boolean) Use local time instead of UTC in logs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `settings`.
